original_test_intent: Verify the raw Type 15 Access Method Address is encoded exactly as required by the selected Access Method—including any method-specific packed index/data I/O semantics—matches the approved log implementation and persists after reboot without dereferencing it.
original_method: Capture raw/decoded Type 15 records, preserve the 32-bit address value and access enum together with layout/status, decode the address only according to that method's canonical representation, compare to the approved platform map and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the method-specific address baseline and reboot plan. The address is metadata only; direct memory/I/O access requires a separate plan and is not performed.
required_inputs: Selected Access Method enum and its address encoding/packing rules
Platform log architecture and any index/data I/O port mapping
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Never dereference, read or write the reported raw memory/I/O address in this case.
Do not clear/write/inject event records or change firmware.
Preserve raw bytes and decode under the exact Access Method; the same numeric value can represent different address forms or packed fields.
Do not normalize a packed indexed-I/O representation to a flat address or assume host OS ownership/safety.
Stop on unknown method, malformed/mismatched encoding, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract raw address, decode method-specific components, validate method/address/layout coherence and compare pre/post reboot.
Do not dereference the address, mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the raw address and method-specific encoding/platform mapping.
Approve reboot/recovery, authorize any separate controlled access test if required and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but decoded text alone can hide the raw 32-bit representation and method-specific packing and could invite unsafe dereference.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type 15 data and report the exact address bytes/value plus a method-specific, non-dereferenced decode alongside the Access Method and layout context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Access Method Address scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and raw address access are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: METHOD-SPECIFIC RAW ADDRESS DECODE WITHOUT ACCESS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve the raw address field, decode its components strictly under the selected access enum, compare to the approved architecture and test persistence without touching the target memory or I/O space.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, log architecture and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 Access Method Address union/encoding, approved platform log architecture and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw representation and access-method-dependent decoding with an explicit no-dereference boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects packing/endian/method mismatch while avoiding severe unsafe access.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Raw expected value and canonical method-specific encoding/map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct metadata address does not prove the underlying access path is implemented, safe from the OS or functionally readable.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different address only with the matching access enum and exact platform architecture; it must record the raw value and cannot treat metadata verification as authorization to access it.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, raw address, access enum and method-specific encoding/map
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw address bytes/value, decoded components, method and layout/status context
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot metadata diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The address field is clear when interpreted with Access Method; unsafe generic log clearing is nonessential and excluded.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw address extraction/decoding is safe without dereference; missing method map is readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw field, union/packing semantics and strict no-dereference boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its critical safety constraint while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE metadata classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates any controlled access experiment and engineer verdict from the read-only case.

review_improvement: Prevents an apparently valid hexadecimal string from being decoded under the wrong method or used as implicit permission for raw memory/I/O access.
independent_technical_reasoning: The address field and selected method are structured metadata; their encoding and consistency are deterministically testable without touching the referenced resource.
